348:t_032:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I won't let you keep spreading your poison any longer!」

348:t_033:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Is it taken care of?」

348:t_033:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「But more reinforcements might still come.」

348:t_033:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, hold position where you are. Be ready to respond immediately to whatever happens.」

348:t_100:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$...! Have you come to challenge me again, never learning your lesson?」

348:t_100:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry to disappoint you. It's not your beloved $$セツコ$$.」

348:t_100:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I know all about it. You're obsessed with $$セツコ$$!」

348:t_100:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is that supposed to provoke me, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$?」

348:t_100:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit looking down on everyone. I only came to pay back what you did to $$クラヴィア$$.」

348:t_100:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Get ready, $$バルビエル$$! I'm taking you down in $$クラヴィア$$'s place!」

348:t_101:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$...! I can't let him have you!」

348:t_101:1.en:
$n
「I belong to no one...! I won't let you have your way with me either!」

348:t_101:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Will you still say that after you take my poison?」

348:t_101:3.en:
$n
「So it comes down to poison after all. You can't fight properly head-on, can you?」

348:t_101:5.en:
$n
「Try it, if you think you can! Don't think your dirty tricks will beat me!」

348:t_102:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I see you are shaken, $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$. ...Not that it's surprising.」

348:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That hesitation will kill you...! You are defeated, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

348:t_103:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You really did a number on me in $$ラース・バビロン$$, cursed wanderer...!」

348:t_103:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... Hatred gives you power...」

348:t_103:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I could use that $$スフィア$$ much better than you.」

348:t_104:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What sun? In the end, all you're doing is hurling your hatred at the ones who twisted your family's fate.」

348:t_104:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I won't become a $$メガノイド$$ bound by ego...! So I have no intention of fighting for revenge!」

348:t_104:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! Whoever would shroud the world in darkness will face $$破嵐万丈$$ and $$ダイターン３$$!」

348:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(The war with the $$メガノイド$$s is over... But $$クロノ$$ was behind it...)

348:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(...My revenge is over... From here on, I will dedicate this life to the future of humanity.)

348:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(The future comes even if we don't become $$メガノイド$$s...! I'll prove it!)

348:t_106:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...How pitiful you are.」

348:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I fight...! To set you free... to call peace to the universe!」

348:t_107:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four $$スフィア$$ within me...」

348:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Soon I'll understand... how to use this power...」

348:t_108:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I've got the Mars colony on my back... If I lose here, I won't be able to look $$ユーサー$$ in the face...)

348:t_108:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Screw up, and that monster cat might really come back to haunt me...!)

uncertain: 348:t_103:0 呪われし放浪者 = 'cursed wanderer' (no corpus precedent)
348:t_104:0 日輪 = 'sun' (matches Banjo's 'The sun is with me')
